page_title: GIR 1-1 RSO | Girona v Real Sociedad 14/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Beek D. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' The free kick from close range, taken by Girona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+5' Dangerous play by Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad). Miguel Sesma blows his whistle for a foul. Girona have a free kick.
90+3' None of the Girona players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
88' Gorka Carrera (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Miguel Sesma and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
87' Pellegrino Matarazzo decides to make a substitution. Jon Aramburu will be replaced by Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad).
87' A substitution has been made. Yangel Herrera is replaced by Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad).
86' A corner kick by Girona is thwarted by the well prepared Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad).

85' Arnau Martinez (Girona) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Girona will take a corner kick.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Miguel Sesma didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' Claudio Echeverri (Girona) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
80' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Viktor Tsygankov walks off the pitch to be replaced by Claudio Echeverri (Girona).
76' Joel Roca (Girona) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
73' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Miguel Sesma and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
73' Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
70' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alex Remiro, who smothers the ball.
66' 1 - 1 Goal! Arnau Martinez plays a pass to the feet of Cristhian Stuani (Girona), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 1:1.
62' Alejandro Frances (Girona) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.

62' Alejandro Frances (Girona) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the right post.
61' Girona have a corner.
61' Arnau Martinez (Girona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Girona.
60' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
59' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Sesma had an easy-decision to make.
59' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

58' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Good work from Real Sociedad as they win a corner.
57' A substitution has been made. Ivan Martin goes off and Thomas Lemar (Girona) comes on.
57' We are about to witness a subsitution. Fran Beltran (Girona) for Axel Witsel.
57' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) replacing Jon Gorrotxategi.
57' Substitution. Takefusa Kubo did his best and is replaced by Gorka Carrera (Real Sociedad).
56' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post!
55' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
53' Miguel Sesma shows a yellow card to Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) for his blatant foul.
53' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
51' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.

49' Ambitious effort from Azzedine Ounahi (Girona). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
48' The attendance for today's match is 12519.
47' Girona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

47' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The referee blows his whistle, Girona are awarded a corner kick.
46' Arnau Martinez (Girona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
46' The game is over for Bryan Gil. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) comes on for the second half.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45+2' Bryan Gil (Girona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Bryan Gil (Girona) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
42' Miguel Sesma blows for a foul after Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
39' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
38' The game is interrupted now, Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
37' Girona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
37' Close! Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
34' Ander Barrenetxea is substituted due to injury. Pellegrino Matarazzo gives a chance to Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad).
32' Joel Roca (Girona) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
31' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

28' 0 - 1 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Jon Martin (Real Sociedad), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go into the bottom right corner. The score changes to 0:1.
28' The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner.
28' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
24' Alex Moreno (Girona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
22' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it high over the bar.
20' What a big chance! Arnau Martinez (Girona) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post.
19' A quickly taken corner by Real Sociedad.

18' The ball is cleared after Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
17' A cross into the box from Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is cleared.

13' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the left side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Paulo Gazzaniga, who tips the ball around the post.
12' Yellow card. Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
9' Alex Moreno (Girona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
7' Miguel Sesma has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alex Moreno (Girona).
4' What a chance that is! Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the left post!
2' Joel Roca (Girona) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Alex Remiro is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Real Sociedad will have the kick-off.
Miguel Sesma will supervise the game today.
